scientific_integrity: Uniform statement is proved using standard hypersurface étale cohomology and purity, supplemented by 14 exact finite-field enumerations; these tests do not prove the infinite family.
scientific_limitations: Only degree q+1 space-filling hypersurfaces; no general degree q+2 extension. The quadratic count alone is a consequence of classical Hermitian formulas. Full-zeta publication priority remains qualified; no independent mathematical audit.
title: Full Frobenius spectra and quadratic rank detection for minimum-degree space-filling hypersurfaces
